fusions.name: Run to Ground
fusions.desc: Rides down an enemy at or below 30% health, dealing 22 damage and leaving it 10% easier to wound for 4 seconds. Its damage rises 5% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it (max +30%).

fusions.name: Flushing the Covert
fusions.desc: Beats through the cover around you, dealing 12 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles, knocking each 3 tiles back and leaving it [Marked] for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Tally-Ho
fusions.desc: Increases your damage by 25% for 15 seconds, and your movement speed by 25% for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Home Stretch
fusions.desc: Against an enemy at low health, your damage rises by 12%.
